operation_scores.name: Signup
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (T, Qual, Compl) not involved in Signup.
Does not explicitly reference the target role map R in stateVariables.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous variables and specify R as the target role map used for credential storage.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Signup | Pre: The username u must not already exist in the target role map R. | Post: The credential map R now contains an entry mapping u to hashed password p.
operation_scores.draft_text: Signup | Pre: The role is Customer, Plumber, or Manager, and the username is not already registered for that role. | Post: Adds the user to the appropriate role map with the hashed password.

operation_scores.name: Login
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (Qual, Compl) not involved in Login.
Does not explicitly reference the role map R in stateVariables.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous variables and specify R as the role map used for credential lookup.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Login | Pre: The password p must match the stored credential for u, AND u must not already have an active session token. | Post: A new token is issued and recorded in T, mapping token to username u.
operation_scores.draft_text: Login | Pre: The username is registered under some role, the password matches the stored hash, and the user is not already logged in. | Post: Creates a new session token mapping to the user.

operation_scores.name: Logout
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, P, M, Qual, Compl) not involved in Logout.
Does not explicitly reference only the session map T.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous variables; keep only T as the relevant state variable.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Logout | Pre: The token must exist in the active session map T. | Post: The token is removed from T; the session is invalidated.
operation_scores.draft_text: Logout | Pre: The token is currently active. | Post: Removes the token from the session map.

operation_scores.name: Submit Onboarding Step k (k = 1..6)
issues: StateVariables list contains unrelated maps (C, P, M, Compl) that are not part of this operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove C, P, M, and Compl from the StateVariables list; only Qual and T are relevant for this operation.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Submit Onboarding Step k (k = 1..6) | Pre: The plumber's current onboarding state must be exactly STEP_k, and the session token must be active. | Post: The plumber's state advances to STEP_k+1. After Step 6, state becomes ONBOARD_DONE.
operation_scores.draft_text: Submit Onboarding Step k (k = 1..6) | Pre: k is between 1 and 6, the plumber's current qualification state is STEP_k, and the plumber has an active session token. | Post: Moves the plumber's qualification state to the next step or marks onboarding as done.

operation_scores.name: Initial Qualification Application
issues: StateVariables list includes unnecessary maps (C, P, M, T, Compl) that are not involved in this operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Limit StateVariables to Qual only, as the operation only updates the plumber's qualification state.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Initial Qualification Application | Pre: Plumber qualification state must be Q_INIT (not yet applied). | Post: Qualification state advances to UNDER_EXAM.
operation_scores.draft_text: Initial Qualification Application | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is Q_INIT. | Post: Changes the plumber's qualification state to UNDER_EXAM.

operation_scores.name: Semi-Qualify (Send to Training)
issues: StateVariables list contains extraneous maps (C, P, M, T, Compl) that are not relevant to this operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Specify only Qual in StateVariables, as the operation solely updates the plumber's qualification state.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Semi-Qualify (Send to Training) | Pre: Plumber must be in UNDER_EXAM state. | Post: Qualification state advances to TRAINING.
operation_scores.draft_text: Semi-Qualify (Send to Training) | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is UNDER_EXAM. | Post: Updates the plumber's qualification state to TRAINING.

operation_scores.name: Fully Qualify (Activate)
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, T, Compl) that are not part of the operation.
Purpose omits the manager role, which is essential to the operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove the extraneous state variables from the specification and explicitly state that the manager performs the activation in the purpose.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Fully Qualify (Activate) | Pre: Plumber must be in UNDER_EXAM state. | Post: Qualification state becomes ACTIVE.
operation_scores.draft_text: Fully Qualify (Activate) | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is UNDER_EXAM. | Post: Sets the plumber's qualification state to ACTIVE.

operation_scores.name: Disqualify (Reject)
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, T, Compl) that are not part of the operation.
Purpose omits the manager role, which is essential to the operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Eliminate the unused state variables and clarify that the manager is the actor in the purpose.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Disqualify (Reject) | Pre: Plumber must be in UNDER_EXAM state. | Post: Qualification state becomes REJECTED.
operation_scores.draft_text: Disqualify (Reject) | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is UNDER_EXAM. | Post: Sets the plumber's qualification state to REJECTED.

operation_scores.name: Suspend Plumber
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, T, Compl) that are not part of the operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove the extraneous state variables from the specification to match the ground truth.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Suspend Plumber | Pre: Plumber must currently be ACTIVE. | Post: Qualification state becomes SUSPENDED.
operation_scores.draft_text: Suspend Plumber | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is ACTIVE. | Post: Changes the plumber's qualification state to SUSPENDED.

operation_scores.name: Reinstate Plumber
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, T, P, Compl) that are not part of this operation.
No explicit mention of the target role map R, though not required for this operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous state variables; only list Qual as the relevant map.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Reinstate Plumber | Pre: Plumber must currently be SUSPENDED. | Post: Qualification state returns to ACTIVE.
operation_scores.draft_text: Reinstate Plumber | Pre: The plumber's current qualification state is SUSPENDED. | Post: Changes the plumber's qualification state to ACTIVE.

operation_scores.name: Delete Plumber Account
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (T, C, Compl).
Postcondition refers to 'user maps' ambiguously; should explicitly state removal from Qual and P.
operation_scores.feedback: Eliminate extraneous variables and clarify that the operation removes the plumber from Qual and P only.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Delete Plumber Account | Pre: The plumber must exist in the qualification map. | Post: The plumber is removed from Qual and P.
operation_scores.draft_text: Delete Plumber Account | Pre: The plumber exists in the qualification map. | Post: Removes the plumber from the qualification and user maps.

operation_scores.name: Raise Complaint
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, P, Qual) that are not involved in this operation.
operation_scores.feedback: Limit the state variables to Compl and T, the only maps affected by raising a complaint.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Raise Complaint | Pre: The customer must be authenticated and in CUSTOMER_IDLE state. | Post: A new ComplaintRecord is created with state RAISED and added to Compl.
operation_scores.draft_text: Raise Complaint | Pre: The customer is logged in and currently idle. | Post: Creates a new complaint record with state RAISED.

operation_scores.name: Assign Plumber to Complaint
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables C and T; ground truth only requires Compl and Qual.
Purpose omits the Manager role and the notion of plumber availability.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous state variables and explicitly mention that the Manager assigns an active, available plumber to a raised complaint.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Assign Plumber to Complaint | Pre: The complaint must be in RAISED state. The plumber must be ACTIVE in the qualification map. | Post: The complaint's plumber field is set to plumberId and state advances to ASSIGNED.
operation_scores.draft_text: Assign Plumber to Complaint | Pre: The complaint exists, is in RAISED state, and the plumber exists and is ACTIVE. | Post: Assigns the plumber to the complaint and sets state to ASSIGNED.

operation_scores.name: Plumber Accepts Assignment
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables C, T, and Qual; only Compl is needed.
Purpose lacks mention of proceeding to site examination.
operation_scores.feedback: Eliminate unused state variables and add that the plumber proceeds to site examination after accepting the assignment.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Plumber Accepts Assignment | Pre: The complaint must be in ASSIGNED state, and the calling plumber must be the one assigned. | Post: Complaint state advances to UNDER_EXAM_C.
operation_scores.draft_text: Plumber Accepts Assignment | Pre: The complaint is ASSIGNED to the plumber. | Post: Sets the complaint state to UNDER_EXAM_C.

operation_scores.name: Plumber Rejects Assignment
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables C, T, and Qual; only Compl is required.
Purpose omits the detail that the complaint returns to RAISED for reassignment.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove unused state variables and state that the complaint reverts to RAISED for reassignment after rejection.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Plumber Rejects Assignment | Pre: The complaint must be in ASSIGNED state, and the calling plumber must be the one assigned. | Post: Complaint state reverts to RAISED; plumber field is cleared.
operation_scores.draft_text: Plumber Rejects Assignment | Pre: The complaint is ASSIGNED to the plumber. | Post: Clears the plumber assignment and sets state back to RAISED.

operation_scores.name: Raise Quotation
issues: State variables list includes C, P, M, T, Qual which are not involved in this operation.
Purpose omits the plumber role context.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove unused state variables from the list and explicitly state that the plumber submits the quotation.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Raise Quotation | Pre: The complaint must be in UNDER_EXAM_C state. | Post: The complaint's quotation field is set to items, and state advances to QUOTATION_RAISED.
operation_scores.draft_text: Raise Quotation | Pre: The complaint is in UNDER_EXAM_C state. | Post: Adds quotation items to the complaint and sets state to QUOTATION_RAISED.

operation_scores.name: Approve Quotation
issues: State variables list includes C, P, M, T, Qual which are not involved.
Purpose fails to mention the customer role and that work is authorized to begin.
operation_scores.feedback: Limit state variables to Compl and add a statement that the customer authorises the work to start.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Approve Quotation | Pre: The complaint must be in QUOTATION_RAISED state. | Post: Complaint state advances to UNDER_EXEC.
operation_scores.draft_text: Approve Quotation | Pre: The complaint is in QUOTATION_RAISED state. | Post: Sets the complaint state to UNDER_EXEC.

operation_scores.name: Reject Quotation / Abandon
issues: State variables list includes C, P, M, T, Qual which are not involved.
Purpose does not specify the customer role responsible for rejection.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous state variables and state that the customer rejects the quotation, leading to abandonment.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Reject Quotation / Abandon | Pre: The complaint must be in QUOTATION_RAISED state. | Post: Complaint state becomes ABANDONED — a terminal state.
operation_scores.draft_text: Reject Quotation / Abandon | Pre: The complaint is in QUOTATION_RAISED state. | Post: Sets the complaint state to ABANDONED.

operation_scores.name: Mark Task Completed
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, P, M, T, Qual) that are not part of the operation.
Purpose omits the plumber role, completion report, and payment flow trigger.
operation_scores.feedback: Remove extraneous state variables and explicitly state that the plumber marks the task as done, submits a completion report, and triggers the payment flow.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Mark Task Completed | Pre: The complaint must be in UNDER_EXEC state. | Post: Complaint state advances to PAYMENT_PENDING.
operation_scores.draft_text: Mark Task Completed | Pre: The complaint is in UNDER_EXEC state. | Post: Sets the complaint state to PAYMENT_PENDING.

operation_scores.name: Make Payment
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, P, M, T, Qual).
Purpose fails to mention the customer actor and that DONE is the terminal state.
operation_scores.feedback: Limit state variables to Compl and state the customer role and that the complaint reaches the terminal DONE state.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Make Payment | Pre: The complaint must be in PAYMENT_PENDING state. | Post: Complaint state becomes DONE — primary terminal state.
operation_scores.draft_text: Make Payment | Pre: The complaint is in PAYMENT_PENDING state. | Post: Sets the complaint state to DONE.

operation_scores.name: Submit Feedback
issues: Includes unnecessary state variables (C, P, M, T, Qual).
Purpose omits the customer actor, star rating, text feedback, and does not explicitly state that the complaint state remains DONE.
Postcondition does not explicitly mention that the complaint state is unchanged.
operation_scores.feedback: Restrict state variables to Compl, mention the customer, star rating, text feedback, and explicitly state that the complaint state remains DONE.
operation_scores.ground_truth_text: Submit Feedback | Pre: The complaint must be in DONE state. | Post: Feedback is recorded. Complaint state remains DONE — unchanged.
operation_scores.draft_text: Submit Feedback | Pre: The complaint is in DONE state. | Post: Adds feedback to the complaint record.
